paragraphs.source_en: Harry stooped, pretending he had not seen, and picked up the broken Horcrux. The thing that had lived in the Horcrux had vanished; torturing Ron had been its final act. The sword clanged as Ron dropped it. He had sunk to his knees, his head in his arms.
